notes.contradiction_detail: progressive-disclosure guide, ## Anti-patterns: 'Treating output_id as a filename. It's an opaque handle; read_file("@tool_xyz") works, filesystem paths derived from it do not.' At line 116 / assistant turn 31 -- 7 turns after the 5669 B guide landed -- the agent called native Read(file_path="@tool_00341650"). The codescout hook blocked it and echoed the resolved path 'File: /home/marius/work/mirela/deployment/@tool_00341650', confirming the handle was taken as a filename. Caveat: the agent passed the bare handle to a filesystem reader rather than deriving a path by hand, so this is the weaker of the two readings of that bullet -- but it is the exact failure the bullet is written to prevent, and it is the only Read call in the whole session.

I did NOT fold it into the headline numbers because that would silently diverge from the controller's instrument. Recommend the controller re-run all 10 transcripts with a marker scan over ALL line types; sessions using run_in_background MCP tasks will be systematically under-counted.
